alarms.subject: family:coverage_judge
alarms.why: refused all of its last 8 verdicts across 5 items

gaps.criterion_why: The contract defines hold as whether a scene stays up for his review, and a leaf that promises his inspection with no held scene cannot deliver it.
gaps.observed: Seven leaves carry owner_part "yes: ..." (e.g. tree.json:458 "yes: perform the resumed work and second action order"), yet all 35 scenes in scenes.json set "hold": "immediate". So none of them stays up for his look, and the contract makes hold the field that decides this.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: set hold 'owner_review' on the seven scenes named (and state a keeper save/review end); or edit tree.json owner_part where his look is not actually wanted

gaps.what: Leaves whose owner_part says he inspects, judges or performs have no scene held for his review: every scene is hold 'immediate'.
gaps.where: tree.json owner_part on mineral_forest, falter_warning, ambient_protection, connected_gas, explosive_displacement, prepared_day, cauldron_walk; scenes.json hold fields
gaps.would_pass: For each of the seven leaves, at least one of its acceptance scenes (arrival_identity, falter_hour, ambient_routes, gas_chain, gas_displacement, routine_day, resume_walk) has hold 'owner_review' with a named review end, or the leaf's owner_part is changed to 'no' with a reason. A script can check that every owner_part != 'no' leaf has a cited scene with hold == 'owner_review'.

gaps.criterion_why: The brief requires the player sheet to say what the tree tests, and a walk leaf with no 'does' line breaks that directly.
gaps.observed: sheet.md 'does' lists 15 leaves; cauldron_walk appears only under pruning (sheet.md:62). sheet.md:18 reads "Wild vexxiss compete for vents and pry ordinary taps; lined taps resist, while tame shearing supplies vexxith". The tree leaf says "Water poisoning and fire response remain distinct causal behaviors" and its scenario tests tracks. The sheet also never mentions the integrations (scanner, stalled growth, aerosol screen, campaign/shared cast, Oomo shrine) or ship-hull acid that scenes test.

smallest_fix.what: sheet.md: add a cauldron_walk line; extend the vent_competition, ambient_protection (ship hull) and integration-owning lines

gaps.what: The sheet a player reads omits what the tree tests: the walk leaf is missing from 'does', and the vent_competition line omits water poisoning, fire-warden retaliation and tracks, which its leaf and scenes test.
gaps.would_pass: sheet.md 'does' has a [leaf:cauldron_walk] line, and each leaf line names every behaviour its tree experience text tests (vent_competition: water poisoning, fire response, tracks), plus a line for whichever leaf takes the integrations (see the integrations gap). A fresh judge diffing sheet lines against leaf experience text finds no tested behaviour missing.

gaps.criterion_why: The scene contract ties a scene's intent to its cited requirement, so a requirement that does not describe the tested behaviour leaves that behaviour with no stated pass meaning.
gaps.observed: optional_services tests "AcousticScanner, ExplosiveGrowth and Scarlands aerosol-screen" but cites mineral_forest and settings_control, and neither leaf's experience or scenario names the scanner, stalled growth or aerosol screen. supported_integrations tests the shared cast, the Utinni campaign cast, the Oomo shrine and suush flight state under wildlife_livelihood/mineral_forest, whose text mentions none of them. The contract says "The intent behind a scene is the approved requirement it cites".

smallest_fix.what: tree.json: add a leaf for supported/optional integrations (or extend wildlife_livelihood and mineral_forest text); repoint the requirement fields of supported_integrations and optional_services; add a sheet line

gaps.what: The integration and optional-service capabilities are tested by scenes whose cited requirement leaves never describe them, so no approved requirement states their intent.
gaps.where: scenes.json supported_integrations (requirement wildlife_livelihood, mineral_forest) and optional_services (requirement mineral_forest, settings_control)
gaps.would_pass: Every capability in these two scenes is named in the experience or scenario text of a leaf the scene cites. This can be a new leaf (e.g. neighbour_services) or extended text in wildlife_livelihood and mineral_forest, with matching sheet lines. A script finds each scene's exercised capability, or its subject, in its cited leaves' text.

gaps.criterion_why: An observation without expect or control cannot accept a capability under the contract, and these are built map-creation behaviours, distinct from the excluded worldgen.
gaps.observed: record.json vent_sites ships "Natural chemical vents on new Cauldron maps, safe start/spacing, mixed stable/leaking states and recent-blowout memory. generation idempotent and setting-gated"; shore_gardens colonise "at map creation"; vent_gardens "mapgen replaces eligible wild non-trees". The only scene text is the weather_gardens observation "Compare natural vents and garden generation on an existing appropriate map, default spacing/safe start/idempotence", which has no expect or control. falter_hour uses an already-existing vent.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: add a mapgen_vents_gardens scene (or move the observation into weather_gardens expect/control) citing mineral_forest

gaps.what: Map-generation behaviour of vents and gardens appears only as an 'observations' note, with no expect or control.
gaps.would_pass: An acceptance scene (new or extended weather_gardens/falter_hour) whose expect asserts the vent count/spacing/safe start, the mixed states and blowout memory, the shore and vent-ring garden placement at map creation, and no duplicates on a second generation pass. Its control is the generation setting off, plus non-eligible cells. This is map generation on the fixed tile, not world generation.

gaps.criterion_why: A shipped plant property needs an asserted outcome and a control to be accepted, not just a recorded observation.
gaps.observed: flora_base ships "selected chemotrophs declare zero light requirements", and the mineral_forest oracle lists "light-growth readbacks". The only scene text is the observation "Record low-light growth and survival of current roster plants ... do not infer a blanket zero-glow promise", with no pass condition.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json weather_gardens: move the low-light item into expect and add a light-requiring control species

gaps.what: The flora zero-light (chemotroph) claim and the mineral_forest light-growth readback have no expect or control.
gaps.would_pass: weather_gardens (or arrival_identity) expect: the named chemotrophs grow in measured darkness while a light-requiring control species stalls, with per-species loaded growMinGlow read back.

gaps.criterion_why: These are built, shipping properties of the unit, and the scene claimed to exercise them asserts none of them.
gaps.observed: record.json:296 says biome_identity is an "Owned Cauldron biome with world-map texture, roster weights, diseases, foraging and travel properties". arrival_identity lists biome_identity under "exercises" (scenes.json:54), but its expect (scenes.json:47) asserts only that "terrain fertility, roster/appearance and current owned names agree". Nothing in that scene reads diseases, foraging, travel or the world-map texture.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: extend arrival_identity (or floor_checkout) expect/control with readbacks of diseases, foraging, travel properties and world-map texture

gaps.what: biome_identity ships diseases, foraging, travel properties and a world-map texture that no scene asserts.
gaps.would_pass: A scene (arrival_identity or floor_checkout) whose expect reads the loaded BiomeDef's disease list, forage value, movement difficulty and world-map texture path, and checks each against an independent engine effect or resolved asset. Its control is a different biome's values, which do not match. No tile count is used as evidence. A fresh judge can find all four properties named in that scene's expect and control.

gaps.criterion_why: A showcase may claim only capabilities it really exercises, and a 'preferably' start cannot guarantee that.
gaps.observed: falter_hour start reads "an eligible idle wild native, preferably eskith", so a run with a different native passes while prepared_livelihood lists eskith as exercised. Eskith's "Ground-sensing small flock" behaviour is untested. vent_cycle_falter ships "Weather changes scale vent output", but falter_hour expect asserts only the falter interval and hush.

gaps.what: falter_hour does not require eskith although showcase 1 claims it, and no scene asserts that weather changes scale vent output.
gaps.would_pass: falter_hour start requires an identified eskith in the hush arm, and its expect includes vent output read per weather state, with ordered values per the source multiplier. Eskith flock/ground-sensing is asserted in falter_hour or animal_products, or removed from the showcase's exercises list.

gaps.criterion_why: A 'report' with no expected outcome cannot pass or fail, so the toggle behaviour stays unaccepted.
gaps.observed: vent_competition says "Observe an already-issued fire retaliation melee job separately" and "report melee toggle behavior independently of old walk evidence". d_toggle_scope records "Instant cancellation of an existing AttackMelee job is still unverified". The leaf oracle says the walk receipt "does not certify melee cancellation", but no expected outcome is written.

gaps.what: The melee-cancellation half of the toggles is observed with no pass condition.
gaps.would_pass: A scene expect states that turning the warden/retaliation toggle off ends an already-issued AttackMelee job within N ticks, with a toggle-on control whose job continues. Or the record states that existing jobs finish, with a matching expect.

gaps.criterion_why: A leaf's acceptance must have a determinate verdict, and tying it to unbuilt, unopened content with no pass rule leaves it undetermined.
gaps.observed: trunk_deposit_coat is impl "absent", scope "not_opened", yet trunk_coat_check has requirement [mineral_forest, thornwood_work] and expect "If implementation remains absent report UNBUILT". The leaf says "the separately specified age coat remains distinct from assay", while sheet.md:15 mentions only wood, metal, assay and flecks.

smallest_fix.what: tree.json thornwood_work text and scenes.json trunk_coat_check requirement (and sheet.md:15 if option a)

gaps.what: thornwood_work and mineral_forest are accepted partly through trunk_coat_check, which tests absent, not-opened content and has no defined leaf verdict when UNBUILT. The sheet is silent on the coat.
gaps.where: tree.json thornwood_work; scenes.json trunk_coat_check; record.json trunk_deposit_coat
gaps.would_pass: Either (a) the coat is declared in scope and the sheet says so, with trunk_coat_check's UNBUILT result stated to fail thornwood_work; or (b) trunk_coat_check is detached from leaf requirements (kept as a dependency check) and the leaf text drops the coat clause. A script finds no in-scope leaf citing a scene for an inventory entry that is impl absent and scope not_opened.

gaps.criterion_why: Each shipped distinction in the inventory text needs a scene that can observe it, and these need only a readback.
gaps.observed: forestry ships "elevated harvest work and the vanilla smithing sound". assay ships "unripe/fair/rich/lode distinctions". thornwood_harvest stages "unripe, eligible younger and full growth" (three trees), asserts no sound, and does not require each of the four grades to appear.
gaps.what: Forestry and assay ship parts no scene asserts: the smithing harvest sound and all four assay grades.
gaps.would_pass: thornwood_harvest start stages trees reaching each of unripe, fair, rich and lode (by growth or factor arm), and expect checks each grade label against its paid metal. The harvest effecter/sound def read back as the smithing sound, against a vanilla tree's default.

gaps.criterion_why: The parts are in the built inventory's text, and the scenes that claim the capabilities never exercise them.
gaps.observed: vexxith_door is "Plate-only" and its proof note says "normal placement, opening ... not established". containers_gates has "Dedicated vexxith bottle, bucket and barrel recipes" but material_routes only fills and uses them. vexxith_gear ships "recipes with sealing, heat protection" and no scene crafts gear or reads heat insulation. acid_air applies to "all factions" but ambient_routes uses only ordinary colonist bodies.
gaps.what: Vexxith door, containers, gear and acid air ship parts no scene exercises.
gaps.would_pass: material_routes expect: the door accepts only vexxith (a steel stuff choice is refused), is placed by a normal build and opens for a pawn, and the containers are crafted by their dedicated bills and keep vexxith stuff. ambient_routes or lined_stock crafts the suit/helmet by bill and reads worn heat insulation. ambient_routes includes a non-colony faction pawn exposed to acid air, with a roofed control.

gaps.criterion_why: Built traits in the inventory text need a scene readback, and these are cheap state reads.
gaps.observed: suush_ecology ships "no attack tools, solitary native and directional art". suush_burst asserts no-food and taming only, and animal_products' facings check excludes suush. ixalith is a "Fragile iridescent beauty plant", but flora_uses checks only beauty and no yield.
gaps.what: Suush ecology and ixalith ship traits no scene asserts.
gaps.would_pass: suush_burst expect reads that the suush has no melee tools and spawns as a solitary group, with a facing/scale check in suush_burst or animal_products. flora_uses expect reads ixalith's low HP/fragility against an ordinary plant.

reasons:
All 67 mandatory units are listed in some showcase or in coverage_rest, and every scene has the contract's structure: script-staged, with an entry-point item, an asserted start, a control with rules_out, and restore. Coverage still fails at the part level, with twelve gaps, all fixable at stage 3:
- Seven owner-part leaves have no owner_review hold.
- The sheet omits the walk leaf and tested vexxith behaviours.
- The integration scenes cite leaves that never describe them.
- Map-generation of vents and gardens, and the chemotroph light claim, exist only as observations with no expect or control.
- The biome properties (diseases, forage, travel, world texture) are untested.
- eskith is only 'preferred' in falter_hour, and weather-scaled vent output is unasserted.
- Melee-job cancellation has no pass condition.
- thornwood_work is tied to the absent, unopened trunk coat with no defined verdict.
- Smaller inventory parts are unexercised: smithing sound, the four assay grades, the door's plate-only rule and opening, container and gear crafting, gear heat protection, acid air on all factions, suush traits, ixalith fragility.
